about_the_game:
Survive The Alien Tracing is a survival, resource management and exploration game heavily inspired by Project Zomboid, Stalker and Resident Evil.

In the near future, several years after an event called "The Great Cosmic Reset," the Fallen of Elun—a mysterious alien civilization—return to Earth, to the fictional city of Neonix. There, they return hundreds of humans from the thousands they had abducted years ago. However, on the same day, they disappear again without a trace.

Miles Kant, a humble astronomer from the underground group Helix-9, is fired after making unauthorized contact with these beings. Driven by desperation and the need to find his missing son—who was abducted and brought back to Earth in the last few months—Miles sets off on a dangerous journey that leads him back to the heart of the company that once hired him.

Soon, strange messages from the "Returnees" begin to appear. Some predict a rebirth for humanity, while others warn of an impending apocalypse caused by the Fallen. Between visions of hope and signs of destruction, one thing is clear: the truth remains hidden, and only those who survive will discover it.

Enjoy this adventure in two game modes: Story Mode and Sandbox Mode.

- Hunger and thirst system.

- Day/night cycle and weather changes.

- Food rots; store it in a refrigerator.

- You can increase the security level of your shelter with padlocks and boards on the windows.

- Shops with hours and NPCs: Merchants of all kinds. Some may even close permanently due to bankruptcy or if killed by zombies.

- Survival items and different types of deaths: By hunger, thirst, bleeding, poison, nuclear radiation, or death traps.

- You can store items in chests or cabinets.

- You must sleep to regain health or use bandages.

- You can craft or buy firearms.

- You can log or mine to obtain valuable items.

- You can swim or dive in different areas. - Two large cities to explore with different biomes.

Survival mechanics: Use your skills and limited resources to survive the dangers of the environment, like nuclear radiation and creatures lurking in the shadows.

Puzzle-solving: Solve challenging puzzles that will test your mind and help you progress in your adventure.

Character states: All enemies have different attributes. You may be poisoned, burned, or suffer from bleeding or radiation. It's up to you to find the resources to heal.

Different environments: Explore a dark, hostile world. From labyrinthine prisons and bunkers to abandoned buildings, vast forests, and radiation-filled deserts. The environment itself will be an enemy you can’t ignore.

Intense combat: Engage in intense survival combat against all kinds of creatures, where every shot counts.

The world is not ready to survive this unknown threat. The chaos caused by the Fallen of Elun could just be the beginning of the end.

The truth is out there… if you can survive long enough to find it. Will you face the unknown, or will darkness consume you?

content_descriptors.notes: Contains dismemberment of body parts, explicit blood in combat, and violence involving firearms and knives.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/8.1/10/11 (32bit/64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo or higher
  • Memory: 3 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Compatible with DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/8.1/10/11 (32bit/64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo or higher
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Compatible with OpenGL ES 2.0 for WebGL acceleration (AMD Catalyst 10.9, nVidia 358.50)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: A survival game where you uncover the mystery of the alien civilization "The Fallen of Elun". Navigate a dark world, solve complex puzzles, face hostile creatures, and use many weapons to survive while searching for the truth behind your missing son.
supported_languages:
English*, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America
*languages with full audio support
